# CWI Attestation Explorer

> Any stranger verifies any CWI attestation in under a minute, no help from us.

- Live app: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-attestation-explorer/
- Repo: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-trust-attestation-explorer
- Records: the real, live CWI memory-chain attestations, mirrored to the public
  repo CumulativeWebInc/cwi-memory-chain (`records/<agent>.json`, keyed by
  attestation UID).

## How it works

1. Paste an attestation UID (or tap one in the live directory).
2. The app fetches the record from the public repo over HTTPS.
3. Every check runs in your browser with the vendored cwi-verification-kit
   (docs/kit.js, 53,070 bytes — byte-identical to the canonical bundle, no
   CDN-at-runtime dependency for verification).

## Checks

- Deterministic schema UID, `uid = keccak256(signature)`, EIP-712 signer
  recovery, refUID chain linkage, ABI payload decode.
- Blob binding is honestly marked **SKIP** for strangers: the ciphertext is
  AES-256 encrypted in CWI's private memory repo, so a stranger cannot run
  that check. The app says so instead of pretending.

## Honest limits

- Kill rule: zero external verifications with checkable receipts by
  2026-10-09 → this standalone app is folded back into the memory-chain PWA
  and killed (docs/KILL-RULE.md).
- Node dogfood suite (`node --test test/verify.test.js`, 4/4) verifies all
  live records end to end, including blob binding of the latest record per
  agent against the live private ciphertext (transient authorized access).

## Machine-readable

- docs/.well-known/agent-card.json — agent discovery card
